subject: Propose two quick windows for 30-min product preview & who to include
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Todd Martinez <todd@blueharbor.health>, Erin Browne <erin.browne@blueharbor.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Propose two quick windows for 30-min product preview & who to include

Hi Todd / Erin —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce token and inference costs for your search-ranking pipeline while keeping 99th‑percentile latency under 200ms for web queries.
- Constraints you mentioned: HIPAA-adjacent data flow, SSO requirements, and a short pilot timeline (6–8 weeks).

To keep momentum, we suggest a focused 30‑minute product preview next week. Two compact windows that work well for our team are below (times shown in ET / PT):

Option A — Tue 30 Nov, 10:00–10:30 AM ET / 7:00–7:30 AM PT
Option B — Wed 1 Dec, 2:00–2:30 PM ET / 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Can you confirm which of the two you prefer? If neither works we can propose one alternate slot.

Also: who from BlueHarbor should we invite? From our side I'd bring:
- Jasmine Liu — Enterprise AE (me)
- Aditya Rao — Solutions Engineer (technical overview + integration questions)
- Marissa Cole — Sales Manager (commercial/next-steps)

If you'll want to include your infra lead and security reviewer, we can keep the preview to 30 minutes (product walkthrough + fit/gap) and then schedule a separate 60‑minute technical deep dive.

Attached: short agenda (30m_intro_agenda.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the recap. Option B (Wed 1 Dec, 2:00–2:30 PM ET) works best for our team.

Please include our infra lead Samir Patel and security reviewer Erin Browne on the invite. If we find there are deeper integration questions wed like a follow-up 60-minute technical session with our data engineering lead (Idll loop them in once you confirm).

One ask: can Aditya touch briefly on KV cache behavior and prefix caching during the preview? Thatdll help us assess fit quickly.
